quasi_flat_zones — SEGMENTATION graph op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.quasi_flat_zones(image, alpha: 'float' = 0.05, *, connectivity: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import seggraph; seggraph.quasi_flat_zones(image, alpha: 'float' = 0.05, *, connectivity: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("quasi_flat_zones"))

Usage

α-quasi-flat zones (Soille 2008): the connected components joined only by neighbour edges with |f_p − f_q| ≤ α. Returns: `labels (1..k), n_zones` (quasi_flat_zones).
